name: The St. Regis Chengdu
positioning: St. Regis hotel in central Chengdu, steps from IFS, Taikoo Li and Chunxi Road, with large classic-styled rooms and butler service
best_for: Travelers who want a central Chengdu base near Taikoo Li and Chunxi Road
Guests who value space, with deluxe rooms of at least 65 square meters
Food-focused travelers interested in Sichuan cuisine

facts.text: The hotel is steps from IFS Panda, Taikoo Li and Chunxi Road.
The hotel is a 15-minute drive from Kuanzhai Alley and Jinli Ancient Street.
The hotel is a 30-minute drive from the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding.
Deluxe guest rooms feature timeless American classic styling.
The hotel has an indoor heated pool and a seasonal outdoor pool.
Yan Ting, the signature Chinese restaurant, serves authentic Sichuan and Cantonese cuisine.
Social is a buffet-style restaurant serving regional and international cuisines, with an alfresco terrace overlooking the Chinese Estates Plaza.
The Empire Suite is on the 28th floor, with nearly panoramic views of the Chengdu business district.
Rooms and suites have views of Chengdu or Tianfu Square.
In-room dining is available 24 hours a day.
Event space includes the Astor Ballroom and five further function rooms.

highlights.text: The Presidential Suite, on the 29th floor, has a 12-meter lap pool, a private terrace and views of the city skyline and Tianfu Square.
Vantage XXVII is an outdoor sky bar on the 27th floor, open seasonally from May to October.
All deluxe guest rooms are at least 65 square meters, with 3.7-meter ceilings.
The hotel's version of the St. Regis signature Bloody Mary, the Chuan Mary, brings bold Sichuan flavors with a peppery finish.
Yun Fu offers four private dining rooms and a bespoke set menu of regional or international cuisine.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.
The outdoor sky bar and the outdoor pool are seasonal; Vantage XXVII operates from May to October.
